why: Line 76's test is titled 'deactivates an existing active non-personal track' but its body only inserts a track and asserts getActiveTracks is non-empty — trackDao.deactivateTrack is never invoked. Line 93's test wraps a literally empty async closure (`() async {}()`) in `expectLater(..., completes)`, which is trivially true regardless of any DAO behavior — it doesn't call the DAO at all. Both give false confidence that deactivateTrack's non-existent-track and active-track paths are covered in this file; a future regression in deactivateTrack that this specific file's name implies it guards would not be caught here (coverage happens to survive today only because track_dao_test.dart, track_dao_delete_test.dart, and track_dao_deactivate_test.dart independently, correctly test the same scenarios).
recommendation: Either make both tests call db.trackDao.deactivateTrack(...) and assert on the resulting row state, or delete the group outright — track_dao_deactivate_test.dart:29-37 already covers the non-existent-track case correctly and track_dao_test.dart/track_dao_delete_test.dart already cover the activate-then-deactivate case.
acceptance_criteria: Every test in track_dao_extended_test.dart's deactivateTrack group either calls the method it names or is removed.
`dart test test/core/database/daos/track_dao_extended_test.dart` still passes after the fix.
